New since D1: appsettings.json holds only Logging levels and AllowedHosts '*'. AllowedHosts '*' is the template default and is acceptable for an API with no host-based routing. Noted, no finding.

New since D1: appsettings.Development.json sets Database:Provider=Sqlite and ConnectionStrings:Policies='Data Source=policies.development.db'. There is no credential, key or token. The *.db, *.db-shm and *.db-wal patterns are git-ignored (.gitignore lines 7-9), and gate.run notes the dev db files are git-ignored. Nothing in appsettings.json sets a database provider, so Production fails closed at start-up: DatabaseOptions validation (ValidateOnStart) rejects a missing or misspelled provider.

New since D1: the dummy Application Insights connection string in tests/Uinsure.Policies.Api.Tests/Support/ApplicationInsightsApiFactory.cs has an all-zero InstrumentationKey. Its Ingestion and Live endpoints are http://127.0.0.1:1/, so nothing leaves the machine. It is a test-only constant, not a real secret. The production path reads APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING from configuration only and commits no value. NET-SECRETS met.

New since D1: Directory.Build.props includes BannedSymbols.txt unconditionally for src projects, with no Exists() condition. A missing file therefore fails the build instead of silently turning RS0030 off. This strengthens the money/time guard (NET-MONEY). BannedApiTests covers it, and RS0030 may be suppressed only in Money.cs.
New since D1: DevelopmentConfigurationApiFactory deletes a SQLite file only when it lies under the test run's own directories. It is test-only, with no path-traversal exposure.

API3:2023 met: no controllers, request DTOs or entities exist yet. PoliciesDbContext has no DbSets and the InitialCreate migration is empty. No [FromBody] on Domain or EF types, and no Version in Contracts.
API4:2023: no GET /policies list route exists. String max lengths and the 1-3 policyholder bound have no subject until F1.
API6:2023 met vacuously: no refund, cancel, renew, claim or quote flow and no SaveChanges. The Version token and refund-sum checks apply from F1.

API8:2023 met apart from S1: UnexpectedExceptionHandler returns a fixed generic ProblemDetails and logs the exception server-side only. UnhandledExceptionTests proves this in Production. There is no UseDeveloperExceptionPage. OpenAPI and Scalar are mapped only under IsDevelopment, and OpenApiProductionTests proves 404 outside Development. Health endpoints return only Healthy or Unhealthy. The only credential-looking strings are the design-time factory's Trusted_Connection string and the unreachable-DB test string, neither with a password. Grep for Password=, AccountKey= and ApiKey over the diff found none.

API9:2023 met: routes are /health/live and /health/ready, plus the Development-only /openapi/v1.json and /scalar. MapControllers has no controllers, so no stub endpoint remains. gate.no-stub shows no NotImplementedException in src, and gate.run exercised the real process.
NET-SQL: no FromSqlRaw, ExecuteSqlRaw or SqlQueryRaw in src or the diff.
NET-MONEY: no double or float in src or the diff. BannedSymbols.txt bans Math.Round and Decimal.Round so rounding goes only through Money.Round.

NET-PACKAGES: gates.jsonl has no 'dotnet list package --vulnerable' receipt, and docs/requirements.md has no approved-package list to compare with. Directory.Packages.props pins System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs 10.0.13 to clear NU1902/NU1903. gate.build passes under -warnaserror, which turns NuGet audit warnings into errors, so no flagged vulnerable package. Recommend the orchestrator record an explicit vulnerable-package receipt before merge, as in D1.

NET-LOGGING: the only log call is in UnexpectedExceptionHandler (src/Uinsure.Policies.Api/Errors/UnexpectedExceptionHandler.cs:13). It logs the exception, HTTP method and request path, with no request body and no personal data at this stage. Revisit if a path ever carries personal data.
